what: Qwen3.8 27B served on the development Mac (Apple M5 Pro, 64 GiB) by ollama: the support floor's reference model (docs/BETA-QUALITY-GATES.md section 1; owner decision 2026-10-07 on Issue #40)

serving.source: ollama library qwen3.8:27b-mtp-q4_K_M (the weights of qwen3.8:27b-q4_K_M with the MTP draft parameter draft_num_predict 4); upstream weights Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
serving.architecture: qwen35: 64 blocks + 1 MTP layer, full attention every 4th layer (16), 4 KV heads x 256
serving.tokenizer: embedded in the GGUF (tokenizer.ggml.model gpt2, tokenizer.ggml.pre qwen35); counts come from ollama's usage. Offline counter of the same upstream revision: tools/usage_report.py COUNTERS['qwen3.8-27b']

sampling.source: the ollama model's parameters (aelix sends no sampling values)
sampling.matches: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B README: thinking mode recommended values

serving.reasoning: aelix sends reasoning_effort=medium (thinking medium); the model thinks by default
serving.usage: openai-completions: prompt_tokens includes the cached prompt; prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens is reported by ollama 0.35.1 (measured 2026-10-07)
